headline: One photo, 2 different works
reasons: The same photo file (fingerprint 71ef49473220) is attached to 2 different works in 2 villages. A photo of one site cannot be evidence for 2 separate works.

This file is not a photograph of a work: it is a 1170 x 1032 pixel image such as a broken-image icon or a plain graphic. The portal shows this same image as the evidence photo for all 2 works, so none of them has a photo of the site in this slot.
The works are recorded as: Other (2).
The photo was uploaded 2 times within 2 minutes (2025-11-30 18:59:48 to 2025-11-30 19:01:44).
